levels.name: Beginnings Determined at the Roots
levels.description: Tighnari's Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

levels.name: Origins Known From the Stem
levels.description: When there are opponents within the Vijnana-Khanda Field created by Vijnana-Phala Mine, Tighnari gains 20% Dendro DMG Bonus. The effect will last up to 6s if the field's duration ends or if it no longer has opponents within it.

levels.name: Fortunes Read Amongst the Branches
levels.description: Increases the Level of Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves
levels.description: When Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft is unleashed, all nearby party members gain 60 Elemental Mastery for 8s. If the Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers a Burning, Bloom, Quicken, or Spread reaction, their Elemental Mastery will be further increased by 60. This latter case will also refresh the buff state's duration.

levels.name: Comprehension Amidst the Flowers
levels.description: Increases the Level of Vijnana-Phala Mine by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Karma Adjudged From the Leaden Fruit
levels.description: Wreath Arrow's charging time is decreased by 0.9s, and will produce 1 additional Clusterbloom Arrow upon hit. This arrow deals 150% of Tighnari's ATK as DMG.
